title: Concept: uv index configured over cleartext
description: pyproject.toml declares a `tool.uv.index` URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `tool.uv.index` URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `tool.uv.index` URL over cleartext.
